annotations.title: Justify a board seat — why it scores what it does

description: The per-post arithmetic behind any Tailwind board seat: give it an X or page handle and get how that account's seeds are earned this round. Every qualifying post since the last payout is scored on its own — X-algorithm engagement units (reply 13.5 · bookmark 10 · quote 1.5 · repost 1 · like 0.5), log-damped and CAPPED so one viral post can't buy the board (a proven word-for-word copy earns ×0) — then only each day's best 5 posts count and they sum linearly. Counts only: no model verdict and no profile bonus weight the score (removed 2026-09-24). Returns the total, the per-post breakdown, and a human-readable explanation — the SAME numbers the weekly purse pays from. Public, no auth.

handle.description: The X handle or page handle whose seat to justify, e.g. '@somebody'.
